name: Sheridan College Institute of Technology and Advanced Learning

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Founded in 1967, Sheridan College Institute of Technology and Advanced Learning is a public polytechnic institute. It is one of Ontario's leading postsecondary institutions and attracts many students from around the world.

The college has more than 130 programs leading to degrees, certificates, diplomas, and post-graduate diplomas.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: Sheridan College offers you a friendly and welcoming campus life. It is home to over 7500 international students from 100 countries. Whether you're looking to attend fun cultural events or make new friends, the college provides many opportunities to enhance your student experience. You can choose to join several student clubs on campus and unwind when you’re done with your classes.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Sheridan College has 3 on-campus residences: one at the Davis Campus and two at the Trafalgar Road Campus. Sheridan Residence offers two-bedroom suite-style accommodation. All the residence buildings are secure with controlled-access entry and 24-hour on-site staff.

Sheridan College Residence also offers international students a complimentary welcome package. The college has various resources and links to off-campus housing providers and homestays to assist you in your search.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The library at the Hazel McCallion campus is designed to support your academic needs with various resources. It provides access to ebooks, magazines, newspapers, and specialised research databases, available 24/7 online.

Sports
Sheridan College has several athletic facilities across its campuses. The Hazel McCallion campus features a new 70,000-square-foot athletic facility with 2 fitness studios, a weight room, a cardio area, an elevated running track, and a double gymnasium.

The Trafalgar Road Campus offers an athletic centre with a large gymnasium, weight and cardio rooms, and squash courts. You can participate in different fitness classes and intramural sports, including basketball, soccer, and volleyball.

Laboratory
Sheridan College houses several specialised laboratories for various fields of study and research. Notably, the Centre for Advanced Manufacturing and Design Technologies (CAMDT) at the Brampton campus provides modern equipment for manufacturing and design projects.

Cafeteria
The cafeteria at the Hazel McCallion Campus offers you a diverse selection of food choices, including international cuisines, and pre-packaged items for a bite on the go. If you’re a coffee lover, you’ll be happy to know there’s a Tim Hortons Express as well.
